rfxchangeDestination.domain: Access journey plus canonical organization/geography/profile/capability state

contracts.canonicalPersistence: Canonical domain collections; journey is orchestration only
contracts.serverCommand: Step-specific server commands; activation revalidates all blockers
contracts.authorization: Firebase identity, current membership/authority, geography/profile permissions
contracts.publicProjection: Exchange-ready/marker projection only after server completion
contracts.rollbackOrRetry: Resume/recover; no visited-screen truth; revoke failed activation

contracts.authorization: Static preview has no production authority
contracts.publicProjection: Reference fixtures must be clearly excluded from migration

rfxchangeDestination.domain: Shared query contract with domain adapters
rfxchangeDestination.infrastructure: Existing Firestore queries/projections; future index only behind repository contract

contracts.canonicalPersistence: Saved searches only in owning domain; transient search in continuity state
contracts.serverCommand: Search/read command only; saved-search mutations use domain service
contracts.authorization: Server filters authorized records before projection
contracts.publicProjection: Cards/map/list use same result identities and coverage
contracts.rollbackOrRetry: Bounded query/cursor; retry error; stale cursor reset

rfxchangeDestination.application: Existing Mapbox map components and LensMapProjection

contracts.canonicalIdentity: Uses canonical marker/area identities from CM-004/CM-008
contracts.canonicalPersistence: No separate persistence except optional user appearance preference if later authorized
contracts.authorization: Cannot infer sponsored/Verified/recommended state; uses explicit projection
contracts.publicProjection: Appearance only over authorized map projection
contracts.auditEventBehavior: No domain event; optional preference event only if authorized
contracts.rollbackOrRetry: Style fallback; reduced motion; preserve camera/selection
contracts.admissionDecision: ADMIT BEHAVIOR; PROHIBIT MAPLIBRE CODE COPY

rfxchangeDestination.domain: Presentation continuity subordinate to canonical domain
rfxchangeDestination.infrastructure: Browser storage/IndexedDB only for explicit local state; Firebase service for canonical promotion

contracts.canonicalIdentity: Local workspace key includes user/organization/record/perspective when known
contracts.canonicalPersistence: Local encrypted/controlled state is noncanonical; shared workspace canonical
contracts.serverCommand: Promote/reconcile command after authentication and current authority
contracts.authorization: Local state never grants identity, membership, ownership or submission authority
contracts.publicProjection: No public projection from local state
contracts.auditEventBehavior: Promotion event/audit only after canonical acceptance
contracts.rollbackOrRetry: Conflict review; discard/keep/export; cleanup after successful promotion
contracts.admissionDecision: ADMIT UX; BLOCK CANONICAL CLAIMS FROM LOCAL STATE
